caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden musical instrument, likely a piano or a harpsichord, standing on four ornately carved legs that curve outward and end in gold-colored feet. The main body of the instrument is rendered in shades of brown, with detailed wood grain and structural accents marked by gold highlights. The instrument features a keyboard with alternating white and black keys, bordered above by a decorative yellow and blue panel, with blue accents at both ends and a central yellow crest with black details. On the lower part of the instrument, intricate carvings and gold decorative elements appear, particularly around the legs and central support, which includes a gold and red lyre-shaped motif. There is a folded wooden music stand above the keyboard, and the background is plain and unembellished, emphasizing the central object. The drawing uses solid lines and detailed shading to portray texture and dimensionality.
title: Grand Piano
